block.description: This resource allows you to manage a Prodvana Kubernetes [Runtime](https://docs.prodvana.io/docs/prodvana-concepts#runtime). You are responsible for managing the agent lifetime. Also see `prodvana_managed_k8s_runtime`.

client_certificate.description: PEM-encoded client certificate for TLS authentication.

config_context_cluster.description: Cluster context of the kube config (name of the kubeconfig cluster, `--cluster` flag in `kubectl`).

config_path.description: Path to the kube config file.

config_paths.description: A list of paths to kube config files.

api_version.description: API version of the exec credential plugin

args.description: Arguments to pass when executing the command

env.description: Environment variables to set when executing the command

exec.description: Exec configuration for authentication to the Kubernetes cluster

host.description: The address of the Kubernetes cluster (scheme://hostname:port)

insecure.description: Whether server should be accessed without verifying the TLS certificate

labels.description: List of labels to apply to the runtime

password.description: Password for basic authentication to the Kubernetes cluster

proxy_url.description: Proxy URL to use when accessing the Kubernetes cluster

timeout.description: How long to wait for the runtime linking to complete. A valid Go duration string, e.g. `10m` or `1h`. Defaults to `10m`

tls_server_name.description: Server name passed to the server for SNI and is used in the client to check server certificates against

token.description: Token to authenticate an service account

username.description: Username for basic authentication to the Kubernetes cluster

block.description:
(Alpha! This feature is still in progress.) Manages a Kubernetes [Runtime](https://docs.prodvana.io/docs/prodvana-concepts#runtime).
This resource links a Kubernetes runtime with Prodvana and fully manages the agent lifecycle.

The agent will be installed as a Kubernetes deployment in the specified namespace, *by this resource*. After the initial agent install, Prodvana will manage the agent lifecycle, including upgrades, outside of Terraform.

block.description:
(Alpha! This feature is still in progress.) 
A `runtime_link` resource represents a successfully linked runtime.
This is most useful for Kubernetes runtimes -- the agent must be installed and registered with the Prodvana service before the runtime can be used.
Pair this with an explicit `depends_on` block ensures that the runtime is ready before attempting to use it. See the example below.
